source: Existing game /api/tracelogs?limit=200, captured 2026-10-26; sanitized client metrics exported below for reproducibility.
scope: Client-reported native GPU incident windows from real desktop/mobile gameplay on current and older builds. Scene/quality are not controlled or paired. Windows can overlap and are selected for FPS drops. Medians describe captured incident windows, not typical full-session performance.
conclusions: Current-build desktop Apple GPU and mobile Mali-G57 observations are available.
Some current-build native windows are below their configured target. This report does not claim native performance acceptance or a guaranteed 30/60 FPS.
Existing phases do not isolate scene-shadow GPU time. Low-FPS windows cannot be attributed to or cleared of shadow cost from this data.
Old/new groups are descriptive observations, not an A/B regression experiment.
Controlled software GPU stress separately verifies four samplers, zero GL errors and exact allocation return after 1→33→1 actors.
